question: What has been declared about that range and what topic follows next?
premises: All that range is declared to be derived from primal nature.
It is joined with destruction and arising.
The measure of all worlds, as told by the speaker's teachers, will now be explained.
inference: The mutable manifested range is classified as prākṛta, and the text now turns to the measure of all worlds taught by the gurus.
uncertainties: The scope of prākṛta here may be technical and broader or narrower than ordinary usage.
plain_english: All that is declared to be derived from primal nature and subject to arising and destruction; now the measure of all the worlds, as taught to me by my own teachers, will be explained.
